description: ZS-EVENT-001 payload of com.zoikosuite.banking.bank-statement.accepted (banking-connector-svc, schema 1.0.0). domain.BankStatementAcceptedEvent — the first real signal treasury-svc's BNK-08 Cash Position consumes to replace its dead 0.00 bank-balance placeholder with a real one. statement_date is the as-of date of the closing_balance it reports, never the time the event happened to be processed.
